name: Carnage
blurb: Northern New England's tabletop gaming retreat in Killington, Vermont, with RPGs, board games, miniatures and LARPs.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Carnage, Vermont's Tabletop Gaming Retreat, is pleased to be planning Carnage 29 for October 16-18, 2026... Killington Grand Resort'
Homepage: 'Future Carnages - mark your calendars! Carnage 30 - October 22-24, 2027 - Killington, VT'

notes: Grassroots tabletop/RPG/LARP convention run by GMs and vendors, not a guest-of-honor event; no mention of 'guest' anywhere on the site, so guests is 'none' for both editions. Two editions (Carnage 29 and the already-announced Carnage 30) both fall inside the window.
